description.p: Converts files. That's it, really. Select files, press Alt+C (or copy them and press Meta+C anywhere, the desktop included), pick a format: done. The result lands next to the original, which is never touched.

Converte file. Tutto qui, davvero. Seleziona i file, premi Alt+C (oppure copiali e premi Meta+C ovunque, anche sul desktop), scegli il formato: fatto. Il risultato finisce accanto all'originale, che non viene mai toccato.

ul.li: Images: JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, GIF, TIFF, BMP, ICO, and HEIC photos from phones
Immagini: JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, GIF, TIFF, BMP, ICO e foto HEIC dei telefoni
Audio and video: MP3, M4A, OGG, Opus, FLAC, WAV, MP4, MKV, WebM, MOV and more; sound from videos; animated GIFs
Audio e video: MP3, M4A, OGG, Opus, FLAC, WAV, MP4, MKV, WebM, MOV e altri; audio dai video; GIF animate
Documents: Word, ODT, RTF, Markdown, HTML, EPUB, and all of them to PDF
Documenti: Word, ODT, RTF, Markdown, HTML, EPUB, e tutti in PDF
Spreadsheets: Excel, ODS, CSV, also to PDF; PDF tables to Excel; PDF to text
Fogli di calcolo: Excel, ODS, CSV, anche in PDF; tabelle PDF in Excel; PDF in testo
PowerPoint and exact Office layouts with the optional Joey Office add-on (LibreOffice)
PowerPoint e impaginazione Office esatta con l'estensione facoltativa Joey Office (LibreOffice)
Quick tools: compress, rotate, crop, trim, split or merge PDFs, protect with a password, join tracks and videos, and more
Strumenti rapidi: comprimi, ruota, ritaglia, taglia, dividi o unisci PDF, proteggi con password, unisci tracce e video, e altro
Send to your phone with KDE Connect or GSConnect, or to any nearby device with LocalSend
Invia al telefono con KDE Connect o GSConnect, o a qualsiasi dispositivo vicino con LocalSend
Keyboard, mouse and touch; light and dark theme; clear error codes and reports you check before sending
Tastiera, mouse e touch; tema chiaro e scuro; codici di errore chiari e segnalazioni che controlli prima dell'invio
Everything happens on your computer: nothing is uploaded
Tutto avviene sul tuo computer: nulla viene caricato online

description.p: Documents, spreadsheets and PDF tables without LibreOffice; Joey Office add-on for PowerPoint; send to phones with KDE Connect, GSConnect and LocalSend; error codes and problem reports; touch; use from AI apps; our own Flatpak repository.
